## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON, Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND and SPY/TLT recovering (SPY RECOVERY: 1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%; TLT CORRECTION: 1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) confirm risk-on; HYG/LQD flat to mixed (HYG: 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22% ABOVE TREND; LQD: 1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09% CORRECTION) is a mild offset.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY/TLT RECOVERY: 1W: +3.99% | 1M: -1.59%) indicating equity preference. Credit stress mixed: HYG/LQD showing small gains (HYG ABOVE TREND; LQD CORRECTION) → credit relief uneven.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.09%) → Dollar stable, yield curve CORRECTION (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.35%) pointing to mild steepening; duration preference ↓ falling (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +0.15%) suggests slight tilt away from long bonds.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals/Health leading: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) and XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%); Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%). Style: Value/cyclicals showing strength versus growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) while EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -6.72%) and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -11.58%) show EM weakness. Europe relatively firm: Europe vs US above trend (VGK implied ABOVE TREND, Europe vs US ↑ flat).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rising: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.68%) and IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +4.03% | 1M: -8.36%) show risk-on speculative bids; IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%) indicates small-cap momentum uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/comms mixed: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -8.15%) with gold GLD RECOVERY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) — metals seeing short-term relief but longer-term pressure persists. SLV RECOVERY (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) shows volatile precious metals flows.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%), UNG CORRECTION (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +0.96%) — sector showing sustained downside.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) and VXX falling BELOW TREND confirm risk preference. DIVERGENCE: SPY RECOVERY vs TLT CORRECTION and XLK BELOW TREND is a MINOR divergence (1–2 core ETFs mismatch) — watch for tech spillover.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and healthcare: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%). Reduce exposure to lagging Tech XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) and weak Energy XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%); monitor credit spread HYG/LQD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) and XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) showing strength. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) and XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) and GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) for safe-haven/metal flow. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) and USO (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -24.25%) for continued oil weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 22.04 (complacency if < ~20), HYG/LQD 0.7337 (credit health pivot), Tech vs Financials 3.2469 (XLK/XLF leadership barometer), SPY/TLT ~8.71 (stock vs bond risk tone).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XBI, XLV and XLF showing relative strength while XLK and XLE show weakness. Key risk is credit dispersion and minor SPY/TLT vs XLK divergence to monitor.
